name: Frame Window Macro
description: Macro recorder/replayer that measures how many frames of wiggle room every input has and shows it in the level.

show-hud.name: Show HUD
show-hud.description: Show the record / play / analyze buttons in levels.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Ignore hazards. Level completions are not counted while this is on.

speed.name: Speedhack
speed.description: Game speed multiplier inside levels. Completions are not counted while this is not 1.

show-indicators.name: Show click indicators
show-indicators.description: Draw a marker with the frame window at every recorded input.

max-window.name: Max frames tested per side
max-window.description: How far each input is moved earlier / later when measuring its window.

lookahead.name: Survival lookahead (frames)
lookahead.description: After the next input, how many more frames the player must survive for a shifted input to count as a success.

analysis-speed.name: Analysis speed
analysis-speed.description: Game speed while the analyzer is replaying the level.
